{{Quote|Welcome to the ''Liberty''&mdash;best ship in the Fleet.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kupalo]]|<ref name="XWA" />}}
The '''''Liberty''''' was an [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] that served in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the namesake of the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|''Liberty'' type]] subclass. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the ''Liberty'' was the first Rebel [[Starship/Legends|ship]] destroyed by the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

==History==
[[File:Liberty-sag.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Rear view of the ''Liberty''.]]
''Liberty'' and [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']] were sister ships built by the Mon Calamari<ref name="SoM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> before the cruiser was driven into exile when the Galactic Empire [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|subjugated]] her homeworld. Nearly two decades later she would help [[Calamarian Revolt|liberate]] Dac and her shipyards.<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref><ref>''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] occupation of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], which ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' states lasted for nearly two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], [[Calamarian Revolt|ended]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Therefore, the Imperial subjugation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] must have occurred not long after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the Empire, or around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

Later in the war the ''Liberty'' was due to be the original recipient of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] according to [[Operation Skyhook]]; however, the sudden [[Assault on the Tantive IV|appearance]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' caused the transfer of the plans from the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] to stop. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and [[Hamo Blastwell]], in [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearheads]], helped two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from the ''Liberty'' fight off the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces while both ships escaped and the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] moved to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Xwing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]—Tour of Duty 2, Mission 12: Protect Princess Leia</ref>

Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the ''Liberty'' was one of the most active cruisers in the Rebel fleet. Under the command of Admiral [[Yamarus/Legends|Yamarus]], the cruiser and its [[Liberty Task Force|task force]] repeatedly led raids and "hit and run" strikes against Imperial facilities and warships. When information came to light on a series of raids being carried against civilian merchants in the [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sector]], the ''Liberty'' was sent to investigate.<ref name="XWA" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:Dsiipown1.png|thumb|left|180px|The ''Liberty'' is destroyed by the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].]]</div>

Operating alone, it uncovered details about a series of Imperial experimental starfighters and proceeded to shut the [[TIE Experimental Project]] down. At this stage, her Tactical Officer was Commander [[Kupalo]], an Imperial double-agent. At some point, it also was instrumental in setting up a mutual cargo-retrieval operation with [[Dunari]] as well as destroying a pirate group, the [[Hurrim]].<ref name="XWA" />

The ''Liberty'' became a famous Rebel warship during its service in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], wherein, with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] aboard, it assisted in the destruction of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']], suffering heavy damage in the process.

It also participated in the recovery of Imperial defector Commander [[Zaletta]], who played a key role in acquiring the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] plans, and later served as the ''Liberty''{{'s}} tactical officer.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:MC80_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|180px|''Liberty'' [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]

Rebel pilot [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] served aboard the cruiser for much of the period leading up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Azzameen was famous for flying in the strike team responsible for the capture of the shuttle [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] and was possibly part of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] crew&mdash;possibly a gunner&mdash;on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the battle.<ref name="XWA" />

Following the discovery of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], the ''Liberty'' was recalled to the main Alliance fleet in preparation for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="SWE6">{{Film|VI}}</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="ERC" /> The ''Liberty'' was lost during the battle, gaining the dubious distinction of being the first ship destroyed by the new Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].<ref name="RS II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
<div style="float:right">[[File:Liberty2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Liberty'' from the starboard aft quarter.]]</div>
Because of her frequent appearances in [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s (such as Azzameen's headquarters), the ''Liberty'' is one of the more commonly known Mon Calamari Cruisers.

The exact designation and specifications of this vessel are still matters of speculation, since the frequent appearances of Mon Cal Cruisers in books, games, films, and supplemental materials are rarely consistent.

The ''Liberty'' has lent its name to a visual layout of the Mon Cal Star Cruiser, in that any subsequent winged cruiser of approximately 1.200 meters length is classified as a MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser.

In ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power Campaigns]]'', the ''Liberty'' is depicted as a different model of cruiser and identified as an [[MC80a Star Cruiser|MC80a Calamari Cruiser]] in-game. However, in cutscenes it appears as a ''Home One'' type cruiser.<ref name="XvT">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power Campaigns]]''</ref>
